instrument: Municipalities Planning Code § 609.2, municipal curative amendment
summary: A municipality may declare its zoning ordinance substantively invalid for not addressing a use such as data centers, triggering a 180-day period to adopt a curative amendment during which it need not consider data center applications or landowner challenges; a follow-up resolution with specific findings is required within 30 days. Reported as unusable again for 36 months. Used in 2026 by Hazle, Butler, Falls, Doylestown, Warrington, Bensalem, Montgomery and Reading townships/cities.

source.citation: Warrington Township Resolution 2026-15; township solicitors as reported

confidence_note: Read in Warrington Township's follow-up resolution; the statute itself not read; the 36-month bar is reported.
